blocked_on: The geometry these dumps were produced from is not in this repository. legacy/ has the FCIDUMP files and the Dice input but no .gjf, no .log and no coordinates. Supply the Fe-porphyrin geometry and this entry becomes runnable.
title: Fe-porphyrin, singlet, legacy regression target
description: The shipped legacy dump for this spin state. It is committed evidence of the bug, not a target to reproduce: the two legacy files put the ROHF triplet 0.67 Ha below the RHF singlet, which is impossible, and their core energies differ by 0.48 Ha. The regression is that a correct implementation must disagree with these numbers in a specific, explainable way.

active_space.notes: NORB=21 and NELEC=22 are read off the header of the legacy dump. The window that produced them is not recorded anywhere in legacy/, so the policy here is a placeholder centred on the HOMO and must be replaced once the original Gaussian route is recovered.

solver.notes: Taken verbatim from legacy/input_back.dat, whose nocc line lists 22 orbitals and so belongs to these dumps.

expected.notes: Known wrong. This is the scalar core energy on the last line of the legacy dump, recorded so that a corrected run can be diffed against it rather than compared to nothing.
